notes.title: Patch / September 2025 / #1.0.5
notes.notes:
The game engine has been upgraded for performance and bug fixes
 Mesh LOD levels have now been optimized
 Fixed certain progression softlocks that could occur.
 This patch aligns the game with the Nintendo Switch version.
 Fixed a bug that could occur with the Lion boss which could result in an infinite loop upon defeat
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to clip out of bounds when fighting the Dragon boss.
 Fixed a bug where it could become impossible to jump across the waterfall.
 Fixed performance issues that could occur in Felina Town.
 Diagnostics data is now collected automatically and sent to Spacefarer Games, to help resolve future issues and performance targets. See our privacy policy for these changes.

notes.title: Patch / June 2025 / #1.0.4
notes.notes:
Updated mouse cursor graphic that was missing before.
 Locked Framerate to 60FPS to prevent breaking game logic and enemies on high refresh monitor rates
 Now fading transitions between loading screens
 Fixed frame lag delays when performing certain actions.
 Fixed performance drops when navigating the pause menu.

notes.title: Patch / June 2025 / #1.0.2
notes.notes:
Upgraded Engine Version
 Fixed a Bug with level 11 in which it would be difficult to cross the gap in the bridge to the other side.
 Fixed collision issues with certain walls.
 Updated to include full native Linux and macOS support.

notes.title: Patch / May 2025 / #1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where an incorrect upgrade would sometimes be performed when selecting from the Upgrades Menu.
 Fixed the level bounding boxes in Felina Town to prevent getting stuck out of bounds.
 Added missing particle effects.
 Improve game engine runtime performance.

notes.title: Game Release / May 2025 / #1.0
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback, we've made the following improvements and additions in GEORGIE-YOLKIE 64 and released the final build!

 Fixed a bug where chests could be opened when returning to the same level again and re-opening the same chest, making it possible to obtain items and upgrades too early.
 Fixed a bug with the Upgrades UI where it was no longer possible to select another upgrade when changing the level on the tree.
 Replaced placeholder image for final boss on Level Data screen.
 Mitigated a crash that could occur after defeating Rattie and putting the game in a unrecoverable state.
 Added missing Level Exit indicators from Level 4 onwards.
